leadText:
(Japanese: カサドシティ Kasado City) is an -exclusive city on Silver Rock Isle, one of the Whirl Islands in the Johto region. 

It first appeared at the end of Plant It Now... Diglett Later as and reached Silver Rock Isle. The trio explored Kasado City's sprawling markets and met up with local gift shop owner Ariene in Hi Ho Silver... Away!. She escorted the group to meet her friend Jenaro, a local silver rock craftsman, to learn more about the Silver Wing. The city's streets are decorated with Silver Wing banners.

Kasado City was also mentioned to be the hometown of in The Legend of Thunder!.
